title: The Empty Jar
scene: At 3:05 PM, the charity shop donation jar was emptied. The back room was locked during inventory from 2:50 to 3:20.

suspects.name: Mira Pike
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 3:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Mira at 3:04.

suspects.name: Noah Reed
suspects.testimony: I was sorting clothes on the floor at 3:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The floor camera shows Noah at 3:02.

suspects.name: Olive Vale
suspects.alibiProof: The shop camera shows Olive at 3:01 and 3:09.

suspects.name: Quinn Ash
suspects.testimony: I was in the back room at 3:05, counting donations.
suspects.contradiction: The back room was locked for inventory, and coin rolls were in Quinn's bag.
